title: Evaluation of Software Quality Through Refactoring Commit-Impact Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.12890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The aim of this study is to conduct an empirical analysis of the correlation between code modifications and software quality. This will be achieved by examining the effects of changes made before and after each refactoring commit, using software metrics such as size, complexity, code smells, vulnerability, and bug detection. The objective is to conduct static code analysis on open-source software from GitHub repositories using various repository mining and static code analysis tools. Our approach involves formulating research-based questions and utilizing the specified tools to obtain results that will enable us to resolve the case study. The obtained results have been summarised and further analyzed using tables and graphs to achieve the objective.

translated_title: 通过重构提交影响分析评估软件质量
translated_abstract: 本研究旨在对代码修改与软件质量之间的相关性进行实证分析。这将通过考察每次重构提交前后所做的代码变更产生的影响来实现，采用软件规模、复杂度、代码异味、漏洞和缺陷检测等软件度量指标。研究目标是对来自GitHub仓库的开源软件，使用多种仓库挖掘和静态代码分析工具进行静态代码分析。我们的方法包括制定基于研究的问题，并利用指定工具获取结果，从而解决该案例研究。所获得的结果已通过表格和图表进行汇总和进一步分析，以达成研究目标。
tldr: 本研究通过分析重构提交前后的代码变更，并结合规模、复杂度、代码异味、漏洞等软件度量指标，对GitHub开源软件进行静态代码分析，实证揭示了代码修改与软件质量之间的相关性。
en_tdlr: This study empirically reveals the correlation between code modifications and software quality by analyzing changes before and after refactoring commits, using software metrics and static code analysis on GitHub open-source repositories.
